subject: Help: multidimensional IRT model with fixed a parameter

messages.author: 8484b6d41f27f2a5
messages.subject: Help: multidimensional IRT model with fixed a parameter
parts:
I am new to mirt package, and trying to run an IRTrees model (with two nodes/factors) in mirt package. 

In my model, each factor has a multidimensional IRT model, and I need to fix slope a1 and a2 parameters for all the items on both factors, so four a parameters (a1/a2 on factor1 and a1/a2 on factor 2) to be fixed. I checked the fixedcalib() function, but seems it only handle unidimensional models. 

Greatly appreciate any hints on if and how I can achieve this?

Thanks,
Helen

Hi Helen,

Have you seen the ?mirt.model help file? There is a syntactical way to do this using the FIXED keyword. HTH.
